reading.a: Deutsche Telekom's release says AI agents handled 40% of contacts in the United States. The release does not specify the customer group. Separately, 32% of T-Mobile contract customers' contacts in Q2 2026 started with software. T-Mobile does not publish how many the software finished.
reading.b: A customer account contacted care 7 times a year in 2021 and about 3 times in 2026; the software agents arrived late in that fall.

release.note: of contacts handled by AI agents, the release says
release.scope: The release leaves the customer group unspecified.

finished.note: How many the software finished: not published.

points.note: about one every four months; [[{v}]] is an average

event.before: first point almost three years before the agents

causes.block: T-Mobile also names: problems removed before customers call; customers using the app

plateB.drawing: The two values are drawn as numbers over their dates on one axis; nothing joins them, because the values between are not published.
